t: This is Resolution, a sculpture by Antony Gormley. Gormley is a British sculptor, best known for the Angel of the North in Gateshead, which was erected in 1998. His other major works include Another Place on Crosby Beach near Liverpool, and Event Horizon, a multipart installation that premiered in London in 2007 and later went on to New York, São Paulo and Hong Kong. Take a moment to walk around the piece and see how it looks from different sides.
